title: Public contract and source prune closure
summary: This iteration closes the remaining handoff items with a repair-and-prune bias. It enables the public-copy contract for real dated artifacts by default, repairs the 2026-07-01 public JSON and HTML, removes repeatedly blocked Reddit community hotspot feeds from the default source reset surface, preserves HNRSS, GitHub watchlist, and Chinese direct RSS requirements, and renames public source-status copy so internal process terms do not appear on reader pages.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "real artifact content contract enforces public copy gate by default|configured source reset excludes ineffective Reddit community hotspot feeds|configured source reset includes GitHub watchlist, Chinese direct RSS, and community hotspots|source reset preflight passes only when the durable source reset surface is present" tests/content-contract.test.js tests/unit.test.js
browser screenshot validation for 2026-07-01 desktop 1280x900 and mobile 375x812

lessons.lesson: Real artifact content contracts must use the same public-copy gate as synthetic fixtures once a report date enters the enforced window.
lessons.evidence: The initial real artifact check failed on 2026-07-01 after the default gate was enabled; the repaired JSON and HTML now pass npm run content:contract.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the default gate enabled for real 2026-07-01+ artifacts and only disable it with an explicit test-scoped option.

lessons.lesson: Repeatedly blocked Reddit hotspot feeds should not be part of the default source reset requirement when stable HNRSS community coverage remains.
lessons.evidence: Default community hotspots now retain Hacker News/HNRSS sources and remove Reddit feed requirements; source reset tests prove GitHub watchlist and Chinese direct RSS remain required.
lessons.recommended_action: Treat Reddit as optional/manual future input unless a reliable ingestion path is proven by current validation.

lessons.lesson: Reader-facing source status copy can still leak internal process language even when debug sections are hidden.
lessons.evidence: The page contract caught public wording such as internal candidate-pool terminology; public copy now uses reader-facing source status wording.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep page and content-contract checks aligned so visible HTML and docs data are both scanned.

suggestions.issue: The already generated 2026-07-02 daily output should be rerun before publish authorization.
suggestions.evidence: This closure repairs the durable source reset and public-copy contract behavior, but it did not run a real publish or regenerate the 2026-07-02 report for production.
suggestions.suggestion: Run the daily automation or publish dry-run on this repaired revision before any real publish.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The next run uses the pruned source surface and default real-artifact public-copy gate.
suggestions.promotion_path: Next daily-run validation before publish authorization.

followups.action: Rerun the daily automation or publish dry-run on the repaired revision before any real publish.
